# MachineChecked

> MachineChecked displays mathematical papers beside their Lean formalisations. Select a claim to inspect its formal statement, proof results, correspondence reviews, source verification and independent replay.

machinechecked.org indexes papers and loads published audits with their authors and revisions.
The tool runs locally in a Lean project. The reader supports LaTeX, PDFs and published audit data.

## Use the tool

- [Getting started](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): run `machinechecked view` in a built Lean project with its paper (LaTeX, PDF, an arXiv URL, a leanblueprint or a formalization.yaml)
- [With a coding agent](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md): `machinechecked check --json` and the Agent Skill
- [Agent Skill](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked/blob/main/skills/machinechecked/SKILL.md): commands, status codes and evidence
- [Reviewing](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked/blob/main/docs/REVIEWING.md): recording whether a Lean statement matches the paper
- [Evidence policy](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked/blob/main/docs/EVIDENCE_POLICY.md): what each check establishes

## Try it

- [Demo](https://machinechecked.org/demo/): a synthetic paper with a printed claim refuted in Lean and a corrected one proved
- [Source](https://github.com/cgarryZA/MachineChecked): Apache-2.0
